'''Società Sportiva Pennarossa''' is a [[San Marino|Sanmarinese]] [[football (soccer)|football]] club, based in [[Chiesanuova]]. The club was founded in [[1968 in association football|1968]]. Pennarossa currently plays in ''Girone A'' of [[Campionato Sammarinese di Calcio]]. The team's colors are red and white."}}
